system.description: A virulent version of the Nosferatu curse leaves you carrying infectious bacteria, fungi, and spores from your Embrace. Any mortal who touches you must win a Stamina-related challenge (Storyteller-set difficulty) or fall prey to illness for the next week; at the end of each week, the victim must test again, recovering only on a success. Most other supernatural creatures have ways of resisting or ignoring the disease (werewolves regenerate quickly, mages can cure themselves, wraiths are incorporeal, and so on), but you can never touch a mortal without risking spreading sickness.
system.source: Clanbook: Nosferatu, Chapter Two: Inside Clan Nosferatu
